coordination.write_concurrency: Re-fetch main and PE before each write; merge by stable IDs; never overwrite concurrent changes.

primary_goal.value: Project-based desktop authoring of multiple architecture portfolios and catalogs with reusable page designs, rich image management and dependable exports.

problem.value: Avoid recreating portfolio layouts and assets for each new document; support project-specific and shared content.

success_criteria: Consistent saved projects and PDF output
intent_notes: Projects are primary; master/page templates remain inside portfolio documents.
Image development already underway in separate Work conversation.

questions.title: Cross-portfolio design sharing
questions.detail: Do portfolios in same project share page designs or only images?

questions.title: Image numbering scope
questions.detail: Continuous across whole portfolio or restart per page/section?

questions.title: Project migration
questions.detail: How to migrate existing saved portfolios into project and multi-portfolio hierarchy without loss?

questions.title: Shared asset publishing
questions.detail: Explicit publish into Global Library or shared reference to private project asset?

business_rules.title: Page-specific once elements
business_rules.detail: Once elements render only on owning page, not on every page and not arbitrarily once elsewhere.

business_rules.title: Page-number position
business_rules.detail: Hiding number on cover must not renumber subsequent pages.

business_rules.title: Safe shared image deletion
business_rules.detail: Deleting one project cannot delete images still referenced by other projects.

business_rules.title: Image source integrity
business_rules.detail: Edits are non-destructive and do not mutate original library asset.

requirements.title: Project CRUD and document organization
requirements.detail: Create/open/rename projects; each project can contain multiple independent portfolios, covers, identity pages, and repeated data pages.

requirements.title: Library manager
requirements.detail: Albums, bulk import, thumbnails, metadata, search, deduplication, safe deletion, and global/project scopes.

requirements.title: Dockable library
requirements.detail: Dock panel alongside Layers/Properties, pin/unpin, select multiple assets, drag/drop to page.

requirements.title: Dynamic image tiles
requirements.detail: One image object expands using right/bottom plus controls and synchronized vertical/horizontal Properties; keep existing tile content and support undo.

requirements.title: Tile Count convention
requirements.detail: 0×1 = one; 0×2 = two horizontally; 1×2 = four in two rows. Vertical count represents extra rows, horizontal count number per row; confirm implementation matches latest owner instruction.

requirements.title: Non-destructive image editing
requirements.detail: Crop, zoom, pan, fit/fill, replace, rotate, flip, opacity, border, rounded/circle/polygon masks, brightness, contrast, saturation, grayscale, sepia, blur, sharpen, reset and print-quality warning; per-tile settings.

requirements.title: Automatic page number
requirements.detail: Dynamic element, page order updates after insert/delete/reorder; option Show on First Page defaults off, without renumbering remaining pages; consistent preview/PDF.

requirements.title: Automatic image number
requirements.detail: Numbering attached to images/tiles; exact scope and renumbering semantics require owner decision.

requirements.title: Text Once and Image Once
requirements.detail: One-off elements appear only on owning page regardless of its position; distinguish from inherited repeated template elements.

requirements.title: Repeat and inheritance controls
requirements.detail: Template inheritance and per-page overrides without duplication; preserve locks, saved documents and PDF output.

requirements.title: Image library persistence
requirements.detail: Original asset immutable; store metadata and per-use edits; shared asset deletion cannot break another project.

decisions.title: Project-first organization
decisions.detail: Project is primary workspace; templates remain inside documents, not top-level entry.

decisions.title: Multiple portfolios per project
decisions.detail: A project can contain multiple independent portfolios/catalogs; default names Portfolio 1, Portfolio 2, editable.

decisions.title: Project and global libraries
decisions.detail: Project-specific images are private by default; users may explicitly share to a global library; use stable references to avoid duplicate bytes.

decisions.title: Preserve master/page inheritance
decisions.detail: Master Template -> Page Template -> pages, including page-specific content and overrides.

decisions.title: Desktop evolution
decisions.detail: Use Tauri 2 and SQLite; preserve existing behavior and migrate incrementally.

decisions.title: No tests or builds by assistant
decisions.detail: Do not run build or tests; user owns runtime review.

tasks.title: Audit live repository and concurrent Work changes
tasks.detail: Read current main HEAD, versions and actual code; do not infer implementation from handoffs.

tasks.title: Design safe project/portfolio hierarchy migration
tasks.detail: Preserve existing templates and stored documents.

tasks.title: Review numbering and one-off semantics
tasks.detail: Confirm exact user-facing controls and PDF behavior.

tasks.title: Align image development with new project library scopes
tasks.detail: Avoid collisions with active image feature development.

current_architecture.note: Intended design, not verified deployed architecture. Project -> portfolios -> templates/pages; project and global libraries; Tauri/SQLite planned or under active implementation.

current_operational_context.note: Build and tests prohibited for assistant; runtime acceptance by owner. No deployment or runtime claims.
